summary: RADCOM Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing that its board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $20 million of ordinary shares, expected to remain in effect for up to 18 months. Repurchases may occur in the market, via Rule 10b5-1 trading plans, privately negotiated transactions, or otherwise, subject to market conditions, price, liquidity, and other factors, and may be suspended or discontinued at any time. No advisor, premium, or closing date was named. Watch for execution pace and buyback support versus the Israeli conflict overhang.
